0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Hhesayo is seeking help with a fruitful endeavor.

24.original: Use the curious nopalitender powder at the designated location.

25.original: Lie in wait at the designated location, then slay the fruitful nopalitender that appears and obtain succulent-looking tuna.

26.original: Deliver the succulent-looking tuna to Hhesayo.

48.original: Excuse me, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. I don't mean to be presumptuous, but you're one of those venturesome travelers I've heard so much about, aren't you?

49.original: I'm looking for help procuring tuna. It's well loved by connoisseurs of fruit, but what I require is no ordinary tuna.

50.original: No, the fruit I'm after comes from a particularly fruitful nopalitender. While I'd normally be happy to go out and hunt for it myself, they're as big as a house. I'd be stomped into the ground or impaled before I could even get close.

51.original: If you're willing, take this powder and sprinkle it about in the field to the north of town. One of the bastards is sure to show up before long.

52.original: I don't know why, but nopalitenders can't get enough of that powder. Sprinkle it about and they're sure to come running.

53.original: There you are! Any luck with the nopalitender?

54.original: You actually did it! I've never seen such a juicy tuna.

55.original: They're said to promote good health, you know. My parents would give them to me on special occasions when I was a kid, as it's believed they help fortify a child's constitution.

56.original: In fact, I've heard the Shetona crush up the stalks to use for weaning.

57.original: As for why I hoped to procure this rare treat, it's nearly my daughter's nameday, and I thought this might cheer her up considering all that's happened recently.

58.original: I don't have much, but please, take this. You've more than earned it.
